sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: Whatever happens this election, Democrats are going to be in a moment of transformation.
sentences.zh: 无论这次选举发生什么，民主党人都将迎来转型时刻。

sentences.en: The party has been united in defeating former President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 该党一直团结一致地击败前总统唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: But that focus has masked real fissures on the left.
sentences.zh: 但这一焦点掩盖了左翼内部真正的分歧。

sentences.en: And at the intersection of many of them sits John Fetterman.
sentences.zh: 而其中许多分歧的交汇点上，坐着约翰·费特曼。

sentences.en: Pennsylvania's junior Democratic senator gained early political fame as the towering and tattooed
sentences.zh: 这位宾夕法尼亚州的年轻民主党参议员早年在政治上成名，他高大魁梧、身上有纹身，

sentences.en: mayor of the working class town of Braddock before he was elected lieutenant governor of the state in 2018.
sentences.zh: 曾任工人阶级小镇布拉多克的市长，随后于2018年当选该州副州长。

sentences.en: Four years later, he defeated the Trump-endorsed celebrity doctor Mehmet Oz in a tight Senate race.
sentences.zh: 四年后，在一场激烈的参议院竞选中，他击败了特朗普背书的名人医生穆罕默德·奥兹。

sentences.en: That, despite suffering a stroke just months before the election.
sentences.zh: 尽管就在选举前几个月，他刚刚经历了一场中风。

sentences.en: But Fetterman's time in the Senate has been bumpy.
sentences.zh: 但费特曼在参议院的日子一直走得磕磕绊绊。

sentences.en: On the personal front, his stroke has caused him difficulties with auditory processing, which you might hear a bit in our conversation.
sentences.zh: 在个人方面，他的中风给他带来了听觉处理方面的困难，你在我们的对话中可能会听出一点。

sentences.en: He uses an iPad and transcription software to help with his listening comprehension.
sentences.zh: 他使用iPad和转写软件来帮助他进行听力理解。

sentences.en: He's also been very public about seeking inpatient treatment for depression early in his term.
sentences.zh: 他也非常坦诚地公开了自己在任期初接受抑郁症住院治疗的经历。

sentences.en: And on the political front, his position in the party has become complicated, too.
sentences.zh: 而在政治方面，他在党内的立场也变得复杂起来。

sentences.en: Early on, he branded himself as a progressive champion.
sentences.zh: 早期，他给自己贴上了进步派领军人物的标签。

sentences.en: He was an advocate of the $15 minimum wage and criminal justice reform.
sentences.zh: 他是15美元最低工资标准和刑事司法改革的倡导者。

sentences.en: He was endorsed by Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 他得到了伯尼·桑德斯的背书。

sentences.en: But over the past two years, he's clashed with both mainstream and progressive members of his party.
sentences.zh: 但在过去两年里，他与党内的主流和进步派成员都发生了冲突。

sentences.en: He was one of the staunchest advocates of President Biden staying in the race, speaking out against
sentences.zh: 他是坚决主张拜登总统继续参选的最坚定倡导者之一，他公开发声反对

sentences.en: Democratic leaders who are trying to get him to drop out.
sentences.zh: 那些试图让拜登退出的民主党领导人。

sentences.en: At the same time, he's been one of the most vocal supporters of Israel's war against Hamas, which has pitted him against progressives, some of whom now feel betrayed by him.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他也是以色列打击哈马斯的战争中最直言不讳的支持者之一，这使他与进步派对立，其中一些人现在觉得被他背叛了。

sentences.en: We talked about all that and the dynamics of his crucial state in advance of this election, where he says Trump is now stronger than ever.
sentences.zh: 在这次选举前夕，我们谈到了所有这些问题以及他这个关键摇摆州的政治动态，他表示目前的特朗普比以往任何时候都更加强大。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Pennsylvania Senator John Fetterman.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与宾夕法尼亚州参议员约翰·费特曼的对话。

sentences.en: Senator Fetterman, before we get started, can you explain a little bit of the technology that you use in order to have these kinds of conversations?
sentences.zh: 费特曼参议员，在我们开始之前，你能否解释一下你用来进行这种对话的技术？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, it's just like your glasses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这就像你的眼镜一样。

sentences.en: If somebody needs those glasses to read something on a page, it doesn't mean you're illiterate.
sentences.zh: 如果有人需要一副眼镜来阅读页面上的内容，这并不意味着你是个文盲。

sentences.en: It just means that you need a tool to do that.
sentences.zh: 这只意味着你需要一个工具来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Or if you need glasses to drive, that doesn't mean you don't know how to drive.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你需要眼镜开车，并不代表你不会开车。

sentences.en: It just means that's a tool to allow you to facilitate the process.
sentences.zh: 这只意味着那是一个能让你顺利完成这个过程的工具。

sentences.en: And this captioning is the same thing.
sentences.zh: 而这个字幕也是一样的东西。

sentences.en: It just allows me to fully absorb what's being said.
sentences.zh: 它只是让我能够完全吸收所说的话。

sentences.en: It allows me to provide a response to make sure that I absolutely know what's been what.
sentences.zh: 它让我能够做出回应，以确保我绝对清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: You've been very open about your stroke and also about getting treatment for depression early last year.
sentences.zh: 你一直非常坦率地谈论你的中风，以及去年年初接受抑郁症治疗的经历。

sentences.en: How are you doing with both those things?
sentences.zh: 这两件事你现在处理得怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, fantastic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好极了。

sentences.en: Yeah, honestly, the only lingering issue after that was just about using this captioning.
sentences.zh: 是的，老实说，在那之后唯一挥之不去的问题就是如何使用这个字幕。

sentences.en: Otherwise, everything else has been back to even better.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，其他一切都恢复了，甚至比以前更好了。

sentences.en: One of the things that you've hoped for when you had talked about, especially your grappling with mental health, was that you were wanting to de-stigmatize it.
sentences.zh: 当你谈到特别是你与心理健康作斗争的经历时，你所期望的事情之一就是希望消除对它的污名化。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是这么想的。

sentences.en: Because at that point, I thought that it's an important conversation to have that.
sentences.zh: 因为在那个时候，我认为这是一场必须进行的、重要的对话。

sentences.en: And if it's not necessarily for yourself, or it's probably someone that you know, somebody that you love,
sentences.zh: 如果不是针对你自己的话，那可能也是为了你认识的人、你爱的人、

sentences.en: someone that you work with, or whatever, you know, they have those kinds of issues.
sentences.zh: 你共事的人，或者不管是谁，你知道，他们都有过这种问题。

sentences.en: And at that time, I didn't think that it was going to reach so many people or penetrate.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，我并不认为这会触及这么多人或产生这么大的影响力。

sentences.en: And I was actually surprised that, you know, on a near daily times, people reach out and say, well, actually, I was just at an event last night.
sentences.zh: 我其实很惊讶，你知道，几乎每天都有人联系我，说，其实，我昨晚刚参加了一个活动。

sentences.en: And people said, hey, you know, thank you for talking about this.
sentences.zh: 人们说，嘿，你知道，谢谢你谈论这个。

sentences.en: You know, it really was helpful for me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的对我很有帮助。

sentences.en: And even times, some people reach out and saying, hey, I got help, or that may have saved their lives.
sentences.zh: 甚至有时，有些人联系我说，嘿，我得到了帮助，或者这可能救了他们的命。

sentences.en: And I don't take credit for that.
sentences.zh: 我并不把这归功于自己。

sentences.en: But I will say that that's why I'm continuing to have that conversation.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，这就是为什么我要继续进行这种对话。

sentences.en: You've gotten a lot of attention recently for some of your positions since joining the Senate last year.
sentences.zh: 自从去年加入参议院以来，你的一些立场最近受到了很多关注。

sentences.en: Not only your story of personal struggle, but also your positions politically.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是你个人奋斗的故事，还有你的政治立场。

sentences.en: And your place in the Democratic Party, which has shifted.
sentences.zh: 以及你在民主党内的地位发生了转变。

sentences.en: Why do you no longer define yourself as a progressive?
sentences.zh: 为什么你不再把自己定义为进步派？

sentences.en: Well, I haven't done that for years and years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很多很多年都没有这样定义过了。

sentences.en: And I wanted to take this opportunity to say that that was never new news.
sentences.zh: 我想借此机会说明，这从来都不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: You know, even before my election, even earlier than that, I've been, it's like, hey, the label leaved me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，甚至在我竞选之前，甚至在那之前，我就已经是，这就好像是，标签离开了我。

sentences.en: I didn't leave it.
sentences.zh: 不是我离开了标签。

sentences.en: And what was originally progressive eight years ago, that was $15 an hour.
sentences.zh: 八年前最初的进步派主张是时薪15美元。

sentences.en: That is now pro-union and legalizing marijuana and just taking the very common sense things.
sentences.zh: 现在这已经是支持工会、大麻合法化以及采取非常常识性的事情了。

sentences.en: And that actually had been co-opted by the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 而这些实际上已经被主流所吸纳。

sentences.en: But now and then it continued to adopt really extreme kinds of views.
sentences.zh: 但随后它继续接纳了非常极端的观点。

sentences.en: And that's why I was like, hey, I'm just a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我当时觉得，嘿，我只是个民主党人。

sentences.en: And then there was a lot of like, well, is that going to be the next mansion or cinema or anything?
sentences.zh: 然后当时有很多声音说，哦，这会是下一个曼钦或西内马吗？

sentences.en: It's like, no, that's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，不，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: I'm not leaving my party.
sentences.zh: 我不会离开我的党。

sentences.en: I just happen to have reasonable views.
sentences.zh: 我只是恰好拥有合理的观点。

sentences.en: And I don't know why that's controversial.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么这会具有争议。

sentences.en: Whether what I've decided to platform about my views on Israel or the border or those kinds of issues.
sentences.zh: 无论是关于我对以色列的看法、边境问题还是这类问题的立场。

sentences.en: To me, that's just reasonable.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这只是合情合理的。

sentences.en: And I don't, I'm not offended if somebody else disagrees with me in the party.
sentences.zh: 如果党内其他人跟我意见不一致，我也不会感到被冒犯。

sentences.en: But I'm incredibly, I guess,
sentences.zh: 但我真的觉得，我想说的是，

sentences.en: disappointed that progressives now are making it more and more about things that are incredibly hurtful to particularly like the Jewish communities and things.
sentences.zh: 我很失望，现在的进步派把越来越多的事情搞得对犹太社群等群体极具伤害性。

sentences.en: You said just now that progressives have adopted extreme positions, which you don't agree with anymore.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说进步派采取了极端的立场，你不再认同这些立场。

sentences.en: What would you say those are?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这些是什么？

sentences.en: You know, like defund the police, those kinds of things like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如削减警察经费，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: That was a gift, a huge gift to the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 那是送给共和党人的一份大礼，一份厚礼。

sentences.en: And they've weaponized that into, in fact, we, you know, Democrats are still getting stick with those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 他们把这一点武器化了，事实上，我们，你知道，民主党人现在仍然因为这类事情而饱受攻击。

sentences.en: And now, you know, just some of these protesting right now.
sentences.zh: 还有现在，你知道，仅仅是其中一些正在进行的抗议活动。

sentences.en: I mean, Colombia, you know, we're all in New York right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，哥伦比亚大学，你知道，我们现在都在纽约。

sentences.en: And a lot of these views.
sentences.zh: 还有许多这样的观点。

sentences.en: And now they're openly being supportive of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 他们现在公开支持哈马斯。

sentences.en: Or they're now calling for the infatata and these kinds of extreme, absurd things.
sentences.zh: 或者他们现在呼吁举行起义，以及诸如此类极端、荒谬的事情。

sentences.en: And they are supporting the kinds of regimes that live and imposes the kind of values that are antithetical to the progressive kinds of way that they would live.
sentences.zh: 他们支持那种生活在、并强加那种与他们生活方式相悖的价值观的政权。

sentences.en: I want to talk about your positions on Israel.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈你在以色列问题上的立场。

sentences.en: But I do sort of want to stick with first the idea of where you sit in the party.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想先探讨你在党内所处位置这个概念。

sentences.en: What do you say to progressives who funded your campaigns initially and supported you and now say that they feel burned by you?
sentences.zh: 对于那些最初资助你的竞选并支持你，而现在说觉得被你背叛了的进步派，你想对他们说些什么？

sentences.en: Well, that's, thank gosh, that wasn't loaded.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢天谢地，这个问题一点都不带偏见。

sentences.en: Well, it's like, I don't know why they decided to support me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就好像是，我不知道他们为什么当初决定支持我。

sentences.en: And if they can't follow me because I'm very fully supportive of the police or that I'm fully supportive about Israel and now you choose not to vote for me,
sentences.zh: 如果他们无法追随我，仅仅因为我全力支持警察，或者我全力支持以色列，而现在你选择不投票给我，

sentences.en: that's a choice that you have.
sentences.zh: 那是你的选择。

sentences.en: But I would find any votes that I've made as a senator that offends or is antithetical to being a good, strong Democrat.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，作为参议员，我所做的任何投票都没有冒犯或违背成为一个优秀、坚定的民主党人的原则。

sentences.en: And I would remind any one of those saying we are, you know, my seat is the only reason why it's mathematically possible that we could even retain the majority in this cycle.
sentences.zh: 我会提醒他们中的任何人，在数学上，我的席位是我们在本轮选举中唯一能够保住多数党地位的唯一可能原因。

sentences.en: Because we are the only ones that flipped in that cycle.
sentences.zh: 因为我们是那一轮中唯一翻盘的席位。

sentences.en: I want to talk a little bit about your own history and your connection to your state.
sentences.zh: 我想稍微谈谈你个人的历史以及你与你所在州的联系。

sentences.en: When did you start having political aspirations?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候开始有政治抱负的？

sentences.en: When did you want to become a politician?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候想成为一名政治家的？

sentences.en: No, it's still a point I don't consider myself a politician.
sentences.zh: 不，我至今仍不认为自己是一名政治家。

sentences.en: Is that true?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: No, I know that's not, may that sound, I'm not trying to avoid using the label.
sentences.zh: 不，我知道这听起来可能不像，我并不是在刻意回避使用这个标签。

sentences.en: I just think I'm an advocate for certain issues or perspectives or things.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我是某些议题、观点或事物的倡导者。

sentences.en: And that just happens to be the job that you're in.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好是你所从事的工作。

sentences.en: It wasn't like, it wasn't a path or traditional sense.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说，这不是一条传统意义上的道路。

sentences.en: But I don't feel differently, behave differently.
sentences.zh: 但我并没有觉得有什么不同，也没有表现得不同。

sentences.en: When I was a mayor, now that I'm a United States senator, I don't dress differently.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个市长，到现在我是美国参议员，我的穿着也没有变。

sentences.en: I still live in Braddock.
sentences.zh: 我仍然住在布拉多克。

sentences.en: I'm a family guy.
sentences.zh: 我是一个顾家的男人。

sentences.en: I remain a family guy.
sentences.zh: 我依然是一个顾家的男人。

sentences.en: I haven't really changed as a person.
sentences.zh: 作为一个人的本质我并没有真正改变。

sentences.en: It's interesting that you said you don't see yourself as a politician.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是你说你并不把自己看作政治家。

sentences.en: What does a politician seem to you when you say that in your head?
sentences.zh: 当你脑子里说出这句话时，你觉得一个政治家是什么样的？

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: That it's a track.
sentences.zh: 那就是一条职业轨道。

sentences.en: You know, everybody's constantly looking for the next job.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都在不断地寻找下一份工作。

sentences.en: And it's incredibly cynical and transactional and now dysfunctional.
sentences.zh: 而且它极其虚伪、充满利益交换，现在还功能失调。

sentences.en: And I've been disappointed on the reality of that part of it.
sentences.zh: 我对这一现实感到失望。

sentences.en: And it's just also astonishing.
sentences.zh: 而且这也同样令人震惊。

sentences.en: And I can't understand why there's people that are willing to spend tens of millions of their own money to try to hold that office.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解为什么会有人愿意花几千万美元的自有资金去试图保住那个职位。

sentences.en: Because then you can get there and be like, look at the glamour.
sentences.zh: 因为等你到了那里，就会觉得，看看这光鲜亮丽的外表。

sentences.en: You know, I'm sitting in a 500 square feet apartment, you know, and I'm like, I'm on Grubhub.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我正坐在一间500平方英尺的公寓里，你知道，我在点Grubhub外卖。

sentences.en: Hey, what do I have?
sentences.zh: 嘿，我有什么吃的？

sentences.en: And watching bad TV on Netflix or whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后在Netflix上看一些烂电视或者别的什么。

sentences.en: And I like to ask all of my colleagues, well, hey, is there like some kind of secret society or like a social life or something glamorous?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢问我所有的同事，嘿，这里有什么秘密社团，或者某种社交生活，或者光鲜亮丽的东西吗？

sentences.en: Like, no.
sentences.zh: 就像是，完全没有。

sentences.en: And even, you know, Romney, I mean, he's incredibly wealthy and he has a nice house.
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道，罗姆尼，我的意思是，他极其富有，他有一栋漂亮的房子。

sentences.en: But I read that, yeah, he sits on his nice chair and watches Netflix and eats salmon from his friend and actually puts ketchup on it.

sentences.zh: 必须被彻底清除干净。

sentences.en: And that's at least own your anti-Semitism rather than trying to hide behind a turn on words.
sentences.zh: 最起码，请承认你们的反犹太主义，而不是试图躲在文字游戏的背后。

sentences.en: I do want to ask you at one other place where you've been at odds with your party, which is on immigration.
sentences.zh: 我还想问你另一个与你的党派产生分歧的地方，那就是移民问题。

sentences.en: You understood that it was something that was going to affect people in your state and beyond.
sentences.zh: 你明白这是一件会影响你所在州及其他地方人们的事情。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a huge issue.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: My question is, the party has now embraced enforcement at the border.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，党现在已经接受了边境执法。

sentences.en: But comprehensive immigration reform means legalization as well.
sentences.zh: 但全面的移民改革也意味着合法化。

sentences.en: What posture do you think the party should be adopting?
sentences.zh: 你认为党应该采取什么立场？

sentences.en: How can the Democratic Party really deal with what has become a very, very divisive issue within it?
sentences.zh: 民主党究竟该如何处理这个在其内部已经变得非常、非常具有分裂性的问题？

sentences.en: Well, we had to address it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们必须解决它。

sentences.en: I said that.
sentences.zh: 我曾说过。

sentences.en: It's like, why is it controversial to say that we're going to need a secure border?
sentences.zh: 就像是，为什么说我们需要一个安全的边境会是有争议的？

sentences.en: And when you started looking at the numbers that were showing up, and at some month, it was the population of Pittsburgh showing up at the border in a month.
sentences.zh: 当你开始查看出现的人数时，在某些月份，一个月内出现在边境的人数就相当于匹兹堡的人口。

sentences.en: Well, if, you know, we want their own American dream and we would want to provide everyone's American dream, that's the promise of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果，你知道的，我们想要他们自己的美国梦，并且我们希望提供每个人的美国梦，这就是对移民的承诺。

sentences.en: But how do you, what do you, what happens to all of them?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么，你究竟怎么做，他们所有人会怎么样？

sentences.en: How can they be okay?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能安然无恙？

sentences.en: And so, I mean, that's a real issue.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这是一个真正的问题。

sentences.en: Democrats can't stop, you know, like trying to tell people, well, don't believe your eyes.
sentences.zh: 民主党人不能停止，你知道的，试图告诉人们，好吧，不要相信你们的眼睛。

sentences.en: Don't believe your eyes.
sentences.zh: 不要相信你们的眼睛。

sentences.en: It's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好的。

sentences.en: It's all working out.
sentences.zh: 一切都在解决。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: You know, it's like, and I'm the most pro-immigration guy there is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像，我是最支持移民的人。

sentences.en: But that has to be compatible with we have a secure border.
sentences.zh: 但这必须与我们拥有一个安全的边境相兼容。

sentences.en: And I will never listen to anyone's other side until you can explain, like, how?
sentences.zh: 在我听到任何人解释清楚“如何”之前，我绝不会听信任何其他人的说辞：

sentences.en: How do we take care of them?
sentences.zh: 我们如何照顾他们？

sentences.en: Where do those resources come from?
sentences.zh: 这些资源从哪里来？

sentences.en: And where do they go?
sentences.zh: 他们去哪里？

sentences.en: Nobody could provide a serious answer to that.
sentences.zh: 没有人能给出严肃的回答。

sentences.en: Do you think if the Democratic ticket loses this election, it will be off the back of issues like immigration?
sentences.zh: 你认为如果民主党候选人输掉这次选举，会是因为移民之类的问题吗？

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: I mean, it's certainly in places like Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在亚利桑那州等地确实如此。

sentences.en: Arizona, and I know it is very meaningful in Pennsylvania as well, too.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州，我知道这在宾夕法尼亚州也意义重大。

sentences.en: I don't think it's the defining issue.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是决定性的问题。

sentences.en: I think it, I just described that as the choice.
sentences.zh: 我认为它，我刚才把它描述为了那种抉择。

sentences.en: The choice.
sentences.zh: 这个选择。

sentences.en: Two incredibly stark choices.
sentences.zh: 两个极其鲜明的选择。

sentences.en: It's not about a certain policy.
sentences.zh: 这与某种具体政策无关。

sentences.en: And it's definitely not going to be about fracking or some of these obscure things.
sentences.zh: 而且绝对与水力压裂或某些诸如此类晦涩难懂的事情无关。

sentences.en: It's not about that.
sentences.zh: 与此无关。

sentences.en: It's about that stark choice.
sentences.zh: 这关乎那个鲜明的选择。

sentences.en: And it's really much more, it's visceral.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上要多得多，它发自肺腑。

sentences.en: And that's why the people that are left that haven't made up their decision are going to have this, you know, what do I want for the next four years?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么那些尚未做出决定的选民将会面临这样的抉择：你知道的，未来四年我到底想要什么？

sentences.en: And I do believe enough people will choose Harris, but I do think it's going to be much, much closer than anyone would want.
sentences.zh: 我的确相信会有足够多的人选择哈里斯，但我也认为选情会比任何人希望的都要胶着得多、接近得多。
